avoidable_by: After every bundle closure, run the test that asserts the package.json/tauri.conf.json/Cargo.toml/workflow stamp agreement (); the previous form blessed independent prefix assertions and so missed this advance. The fix tightens the relationship check to derive the expected stamp from package.json so a future tranche promotion can only ever move both together.
cause: The v0.6.120 publish at 5c432a1b stamped the wrong version (0.6.120) because the SD-27 closure did not advance the tranche-base digit from 6 to 7. The release bundled SD-27's closure work (ARG + PU ingestion, Shape B v1, player reachability) but the publish-time stamp stayed at 0.6 because the bump did not land in the repo before the publish. Additionally, the workflow's release-notes-path hardcoded docs/release/SD-16/release-notes.md (a 67-line SD-16 document) instead of pointing at the substantive content of the cut, so the published release body was either stale or — as in this case — manually overridden with the wrong bundle's notes (SD-21 instead of the tranche/6 + tranche/7 content).
cost: 1 cycle for diagnosis + 1 cycle for fix; published release body + workflow + 14 files updated
summary: Missed advance + stale release-notes source — fixed by 0.6 → 0.7.0 bump + new docs/release/v0.7/release-notes.md
what: Fixed v0.6.120 → v0.7.120 missed advance + release-notes body reclassification

summary: v0.7.121 (not v0.7.0/v0.7.1) is the correct first v0.7 stamp after PR #358 lands; GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER is shared across the 0.6.x/0.7.x lanes
